To achieve Accomplished, correct the technical misconception regarding equatorial launches—retrograde SSOs require extra delta-V to negate Earth's rotation. Additionally, model target coverage and revisit intervals over the Great Barrier Reef, fully cite external figures like Image 3, and complete truncated sentences in your end-of-life drag sail analysis.","C3":"In your Conclusion, you clearly summarised key design selections such as the Vega E launcher, SSO parameters, and ground station.
